title: Abstract Factory Pattern
overview: Provide an interface for creating families of related objects without specifying their concrete classes.
useCases: Creating a family of related objects designed to work together
When you want to switch between entire families of objects (e.g. Windows vs Mac UI) without changing client code
When the system must be independent of how its products are created, composed, or represented
exampleUses: A game engine that swaps between a DirectX rendering family and an OpenGL rendering family without touching game logic
A cloud deployment tool that creates provider-specific resources (AWS vs Azure) through a common factory interface
A testing framework that switches between a real database factory and an in-memory database factory for unit tests
